# Swift Sail Shipping L.L.C.
> Licensed UAE freight forwarding, logistics, and customs brokerage company headquartered in Dubai.

Swift Sail Shipping L.L.C. is a Dubai-based sovereign freight forwarding and logistics operator providing ocean freight (FCL/LCL), air cargo, UAE customs brokerage (Mirsal 2), and project cargo/heavy-lift services. Operating from Dubai Maritime City, Jebel Ali Port, and Port Khalid Sharjah.

## Key facts
- Phone: +971 55 342 4700
- Email: info@swiftsailship.com
- Address: Tanvi Business Centre, M - 101, Abu Hail, Dubai, United Arab Emirates
- Licenses: UAE Customs Brokerage (Mirsal 2), MOIAT industrial duty exemption
- Coverage: Jebel Ali Port, Port Khalid Sharjah, Khalifa Port, DXB & DWC airports

## Core services
- [Ocean Freight & Vessel Chartering](https://www.swiftsailship.com/services#ocean-freight): FCL/LCL consolidation, reefer, flat rack, open top
- [Air Cargo Velocity & Charters](https://www.swiftsailship.com/services#air-cargo): NFO express, pharma/cold chain, IATA DG handling
- [UAE Customs Brokerage & Free Zone Entry](https://www.swiftsailship.com/services#customs-clearance): Mirsal 2 declarations, duty exemptions
- [Project Cargo & Heavy Lift Operations](https://www.swiftsailship.com/services#breakbulk-project): OOG, RoRo, route surveys

## Process
- [How It Works](https://www.swiftsailship.com/how-it-works): 6-stage freight lifecycle
- [Request a Quotation](https://www.swiftsailship.com/get-quote): rates within 2 business hours
